findings.title: The non-convergence stop is never evaluated on the `merging -> rework` path, leaving that identical-failure loop unbounded
lib/rework.sh is now sourced by runners/orchid-drive but was not added to INV-13's audited POLICIES set
A header-truncated (non-empty, no `---`) evidence log digests to the empty-stream signature, so two torn captures read as one repeat
The reroute journal entry is written before drive_launch, so a launch that spawns nothing (exit 14/18) still records "this attempt runs on <engine>"
